question: Does the guarded eight-row exact-c32 M384 attention schedule preserve the pinned target-verification consumer and reduce component and matched endpoint time on H200?
why_now: The DFlash predecessor produced a typed semantic rejection and released the H200 with the exact target checkpoint, source, image, and caches resident. The fixed-M384 lane is independent of DFlash acceptance semantics, its offline implementation and exact-consumer oracle are complete, and measured trace evidence assigns 25.36% to 28.93% of qualified request time to complete target verification.

runtime_identity.shape: c32, NGRAM depth 12, q_len 12, M384 target verification, FP8-E5M2 paged KV, BF16 query and output

execution.claim: Verify this binding and every bound hash, read the current bench identity from runtime/gpus.json, require the exact available instance and disk above with at least 90 lifecycle minutes remaining, then claim once.
execution.checkpoint: Hash-reconcile the resident target against every checkpoint file in IMMUTABLE_PACKET.json and hard-link only exact matching bytes into the immutable experiment path. If the completion manifest is unavailable, hash the resident files once; absence of a manifest is not a mismatch. Do not download, reconstruct, overwrite, or restage checkpoint bytes.
execution.staging: Stage only the immutable project packet and pinned SGLang image. Preserve the released DFlash target, draft, source, image, and CUDA caches.
execution.component: Run the actual pinned stock and candidate exact-consumer CUDA-graph A/B with deterministic replay, finite numerical equivalence, request ownership, KV, mask, and graph-key gates. Repair only a localized invalid launcher or observer boundary under the retained claim.
execution.counters: If the candidate is correct and reproducibly faster, collect only four decisive NCU launches for registers, shared memory, grid waves, HBM bytes, and L2 bytes.
execution.endpoint: If the correct warm component remains positively bounded without a pathological resource regression, run one profiler-off matched c32 control/candidate endpoint pair. Retain any reproducible exact positive effect; claim the campaign objective only from this endpoint.
execution.terminal: Retrieve all typed component, counter, and conditional pair artifacts; persist FIXED_M384_EXECUTOR_TERMINAL.json with cumulative exposure; stop all experiment processes and release the bench available by 2026-07-25T21:30:00Z.

budgets.storage: At most 12 GiB of new project artifacts; reuse checkpoint bytes in place.

prohibitions: Do not replay or repair the rejected DFlash diagnostic or its unstarted c32 pair.
Do not run the dependent DFlash FP8-head stack.
Do not restage the target checkpoint.
Do not replay rejected BLOCK_M=16, BLOCK_M=32, 1x2x1 cluster, mask, penalty, or allocator candidates.
Do not weaken exact-consumer correctness, graph replay, endpoint semantics, token accounting, or failure gates.
Do not create, resize, reboot, drain, delete, or otherwise mutate provider resources.
